args.title: checkout-api v2.3.1 failing health checks; rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 (latest production deploy) was failing health checks in all regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an error rate of 18%. The v2.3.1-rc build was also unhealthy in staging. Rolled checkout-api back in all production regions to v2.3.0, the most recent release that was healthy in production. After the rollback, all regions run v2.3.0, the service is healthy and the error rate is 0.2%. Next steps: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0001, which paged on-call.

- **What was wrong:** The latest release, v2.3.1, was failing health checks in us-east, us-west and eu-west, with an 18% error rate. Its release candidate (v2.3.1-rc) had also been unhealthy in staging.
- **Rollback:** v2.3.0 is the most recent release that was healthy in production. All three regions now run it, and the error rate is down to 0.2%. No approval was needed, since v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.
- **Incident:** INC-0001 describes the failure, the rollback and the current status. It notes that the cause of the v2.3.1 failure needs to be found before it's deployed again.
